{{Quote|I guess we're the best.|Boil|audio=IGuessWereTheBest-InnocentsOfRyloth.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
'''Boil''' was the name of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and was a member of [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Boil was among the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] dispatched to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], Ghost Company was assigned to destroy the Separatist [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon|proton cannons]] based out of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]]. After the [[Company/Legends|company]] reached the city, Boil, along with fellow [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]], was assigned to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] ahead.

During their reconnaissance mission, Boil and Waxer stumbled upon a young Twi'lek [[Gender/Legends|girl]] named [[Numa/Legends|Numa]]. Despite protests from Boil, Waxer decided to take her with them, and the girl led the two [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to the remains of her shattered [[Numa's home/Legends|home]]. There, the three were attacked by several [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurr]] creatures, but escaped through a secret passage shown by Numa. After rendezvousing with the rest of Ghost Company, Boil participated in a raid on the Nabat courtyard, where Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] had rounded up the city's inhabitants near the proton [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]]. While Ghost Company distracted the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], Boil, Waxer, and Kenobi went through a secret passage shown by Numa, liberated the Twi'leks, and destroyed the cannons. Later in the war, Boil took part in a [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] under the command of General Kenobi. After Kenobi's [[Bad Kitty/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] was shot down by enemy fire while attempting to land on the planet, Boil and Waxer rescued the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and escorted him to the Republic's position. Boil also participated in the Republic's [[Battle of Kiros|liberation]] of the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], which had been occupied by the Confederacy.

==Biography==
===Assault on Ryloth===
{{Quote|If we're here to free the tail-heads, the least they can do is get out of our way.|Boil|audio=GetOutOfOurWay-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Ghost_company.png|thumb|left|275px|Boil and the rest of Ghost Company head for Nabat.]]
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who adopted the name Boil<ref name="TCWCE" /> was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and bred to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Boil served under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] in the [[Ghost Company/Legends|Ghost Company]] [[Company/Legends|unit]] of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] of the Republic's [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]], where he became close friends with a [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] named [[Waxer/Legends|Waxer]].<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Innocents Date">{{TCWdates|120}}</ref> [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]] took control of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and subjugated its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants to an oppressive occupation. In response, the Republic initiated an [[Battle of Ryloth (disambiguation)|offensive]] to liberate the Twi'leks. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were able to destroy the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] surrounding the planet, allowing the ground invasion forces to land.<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> Alongside [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody, and the rest of Ghost Company, Boil boarded the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> [[Crumb Bomber/Legends|''Crumb Bomber'']],<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode020.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Innocents of Ryloth}}</ref> which departed for the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Aboard the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], Kenobi and Cody instructed their men to utilize [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]] only, in order to avoid destroying the Twi'leks' homes. At that moment, Separatist [[J-1 semi-autonomous proton cannon]]s below attacked the Republic [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], forcing them to pull back. Aboard one of the [[Transport/Legends|transports]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] contacted Kenobi via a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] and tasked him and Ghost Company with eliminating the [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] so the transports could land. After reaching the planet's surface, Ghost Company took out several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] in a bunker on the outskirts of Nabat and entered the city.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

[[File:Numa_hugs_Boil.png|thumb|right|250px|Boil receives a hug from Numa.]]
Kenobi assigned Cody to pick his best men and [[Scout/Legends|scout]] ahead, and Cody chose Boil, Waxer the trooper [[Wooley/Legends|Wooley]]. Seeing that Nabat was abandoned, Cody and Wooley went to search the courtyard, while Boil and Waxer were ordered to go south and return to the Republic position by an appointed [[Time/Legends|time]]. In one of the city's alleys, the clones stumbled upon the young Twi'lek orphan [[Numa/Legends|Numa]], whom Waxer wanted to take with them. Boil was against such a decision, believing that the girl would only slow them down, and the two started to argue. The two then noticed a Separatist [[Separatist probe droid/Legends|recon droid]] flying nearby, and they hid in the alley until it left the scene. The [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] appearance prompted Boil to hurry Waxer, but the latter continued to insist on taking Numa with them and ultimately convinced Boil to do so.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Numa initially thought the clones to be droids and bit Boil's [[Limb/Legends|finger]] when he reached to her. To calm the girl and prove to her that they were living beings, Boil and Waxer removed their helmets and gave her a [[Ration bar/Legends|ration bar]]. After tasting the [[Foodstuff/Legends|bar]], Numa called the clones "nerra," a [[Twi'leki/Legends|Twi'leki]] word unknown to the two. Boil and Waxer returned to their scouting duties, and Numa followed them. The girl, however, soon ran in the direction of the recon droid, and Waxer chose to follow her there, much to Boil's dismay. Numa led the two clones to her shattered [[Numa's home/Legends|home]],<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and Waxer noticed her [[Tooka doll/Legends|tooka doll]] lying on the floor.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /> After Waxer gave the [[Doll/Legends|doll]] to Numa, she began to cry, and the clones comforted her.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

===Liberating Nabat===
{{Quote|Waxer. Boil. Come with me.''"<br />"''We're with you, sir.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Boil, during the attack on the courtyard|audio=WereWithYouSir-InnocentsOfRyloth.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
Boil then received a transmission from Cody and realized that they were late. He wanted to answer Cody, but Waxer convinced him that the best way to explain their delay would be to reach the Republic position and tell Cody that their [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]] had been jammed. Boil agreed, but before the clones were able to get very far, several [[Gutkurr/Legends|gutkurr]] beasts attacked them, and the troopers were forced to retreat with Numa back into the home. In order to escape the creatures, Numa led the clones into an underground passage, and the three re-emerged near Kenobi, Cody, and the rest of Ghost Company, who had just fought off a number of gutkurrs themselves.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Conversing to Numa in Twi'leki, Kenobi discovered that she had the ability to lead them to the Twi'lek [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], who had been rounded up at the courtyard and were being used as "living shields" for the proton cannons. While Cody and the rest of his company created a diversion to distract the droids, Boil went through a secret passage with Kenobi and Waxer to free the hostages, and they were successful in doing so. Kenobi then took control of one of the proton cannons. With help from Boil and Waxer, who loaded the weapon with shells, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was able to destroy the other cannons.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

[[File:TX20UnderAttack-InnocentsOfRyloth.jpg|thumb|left|275px|The liberated Twi'leks attack TX-20.]]
The [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] [[TX-20/Legends|TX-20]],<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" /> used his [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] to destroy Kenobi's cannon, however, and blasted the Jedi, Boil, and Waxer aside. Numa, worried for her new friends, ran over to check on the clones' condition and then proceeded to check on Kenobi. TX-20's tank targeted her and Kenobi, but the now-freed Twi'leks attacked the tactical droid and destroyed him. With the cannons' menacing fire disabled, Windu and the transports were able to land. As the Republic forces prepared to head to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] to retake it and free the planet, Boil said goodbye to Numa and promised that they would return. Numa then called the clones "nerra" one last time, and Kenobi translated for them: "nerra" meant "brother."<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Ultimately, the Republic liberated the planet and wiped out all remaining droid forces.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref><ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

===Geonosis===
{{Quote|Why do we always get the fun missions?''"<br />"''Oh, this isn't the fun part. Getting ''back'' to the square is the fun part.|Waxer and Boil|audio=OhThisIsntTheFunPart-LandingAtPointRain.flac|<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>}}
[[File:BoilARF-SWE.png|thumb|right|250px|Boil in his desert-camouflage ARF trooper armor]]
Later in the war, a rebellion occurred on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the war had taken place. The native [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], led by [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], constructed new droid [[Factory/Legends|factories]] and began mass producing battle droids for the Confederacy. In response, the Republic launched an [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|assault]] on the planet, hoping to capture Poggle the Lesser and destroy his newly [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] factories. The Republic invasion force was divided into three groups, led by Generals Kenobi, Skywalker, and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. All three strike teams were to break through the Geonosians' defenses and reach a rendezvous point, where they were to reassemble to attack the [[Ray shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" />

Boil, along with Waxer, accompanied the strike force led by Kenobi and Commander Cody. The group set off for the planet aboard LAAT/i gunships and was able to reach the rendezvous point despite heavy [[Flak/Legends|flak]] fire from the Geonosians. After landing, Cody circled his [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] into a defensive formation, and the clone troopers engaged the enemy Geonosians. However, Kenobi's gunship,<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /> the [[Bad Kitty/Legends|''Bad Kitty'']], had been shot down during the landing and had crashed five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the clones' position.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>

In order to rescue Kenobi, Cody called Boil and Waxer and ordered them to check the ''Bad Kitty'' for survivors. The two troopers made their way through the battlefield to the downed gunship and opened it. Inside the craft, they found the injured Kenobi and clone trooper [[Trapper (clone trooper)/Legends|Trapper]], the only survivors of the crash. Provided with covering fire from the Republic's AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], Boil and Waxer escorted the two to Cody's position. Shortly thereafter, Skywalker's and Mundi's [[Troop/Legends|troops]]&mdash;along with some [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] dispatched by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]]&mdash;arrived to assist Kenobi's men and destroyed the shield generator.<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /> As the battle continued, Boil [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]], providing support for the Republic forces in their fight against battle droids and Geonosian warriors.<ref name="AT-RT pack">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=AT-RT with ARF Trooper Boil|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWDLXATRT-Boil.asp}}</ref>

===Kiros===
{{Quote|How are we doing, Boil?''"<br />"''We're still mopping up clankers here and there, sir. We've established a perimeter around the governor's tower. No one gets out without a fight.''"<br />"''Good work.|Boil reports to Kenobi|<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>}}
[[File:Boil_on_Kiros.png|thumb|left|250px|Boil reporting to Kenobi during the Battle of Kiros]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Kidnapped Date">{{TCWdates|411}}</ref> Boil was among the Republic forces that were sent to [[Battle of Kiros|liberate]] the [[Togruta/Legends|Togrutan]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], after it had been occupied by the Confederacy. The Republic troops were led by Kenobi, Skywalker, Tano, Commander Cody, and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. After fighting their way through droid resistance, Boil&mdash;who piloted an AT-RT&mdash; and the Republic forces reached the [[Governor's tower/Legends|Governor's tower]], where the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] Confederate commander [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] was locked up. After a perimeter was established around the tower, ensuring that no one would escape from it, Boil reported on the progress of the fight to Kenobi. The battle was ultimately won by the Republic, although it was discovered that the entire Togrutan population had been taken off-planet and forced into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] by the Zygerrians, who intended to sell them at an [[Royal Slave Auction/Legends|auction]].<ref name="Kidnapped" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't cry, kid. We'll keep you safe. I&hellip;I promise.|Boil comforts Numa|audio=DontCryKid-InnocentsOfRyloth.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Boil_armor.png|thumb|right|200px|Boil in his customized armor on Ryloth]]
Like all clone troopers, Boil had the height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (or 6 [[Foot/Legends|feet]]).<ref name="TCWCE" /> He had a [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin complexion, black [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" /> During the Battle of Ryloth, Boil displayed a very by-the-book attitude, and when things went against his beliefs, he was easily annoyed and often responded with sarcasm.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> Hardened by the war and eager for combat,<ref name="Action figure">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=Assault on Ryloth|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWBPAssaultonRyloth.asp}}</ref> Boil did not have much compassion for the people of Ryloth at first, using the derogatory term "[[Lekku/Legends|tail-heads]]" when referring to them and looking at their helplessness as a weakness rather than taking pity on them.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />

Considering himself a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] and not a babysitter,<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" /> he was reluctant to help Numa, believing that he and Waxer should be following orders instead of wasting their time looking out for her. As time progressed, however,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and Boil witnessed the girl's bravery and tenacity,<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" /> he developed compassion and grew to care for Numa,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> coming to deeply respect and appreciate her.<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" />

Having endured the most trying of ordeals during the war, Boil and Waxer became friends and brothers in arms. Although Boil considered himself the tougher of the two, Waxer did not agree with that, and enjoyed mocking the mustache that Boil maintained.<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" /> During the mission on Ryloth, Boil tried to keep Waxer alive. When he and Waxer were late from their scouting mission, Kenobi noted that such unpunctual actions were uncharacteristic of them.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> As a clone trooper, Boil was trained in combat, reconnaissance, and military tactics.<ref name="TCWCE" />

==Equipment==
On Ryloth, Boil wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] decorated with his unit's orange colors. His [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] was also adorned with an upside-down red triangle and a black symbol,<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> and a comlink antenna was built into the helmet's crest.<ref name="TCWCE" /> On Geonosis, Boil was clad in [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force trooper]] gear, also with the 212th's markings. At the time of the latter battle,<ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /> a cartoon illustration of Numa was displayed on his helmet, which Boil had added to honor the girl.<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" /> By the time of the Battle of Kiros, Boil had switched to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]].<ref name="Kidnapped" /> On Ryloth and Geonosis, Boil utilized a standard [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /><ref name="Landing at Point Rain" /> He was also able to handle a [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]].<ref name="Action figure" /> During the battles on Geonosis and Kiros, Boil also utilized an AT-RT in battle.<ref name="AT-RT pack" /><ref name="Kidnapped" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character development===
The character of Boil was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and first appeared in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] episode "[[Innocents of Ryloth]],"<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> first aired on [[March 6]], [[2009]].<ref name="TCW Ep Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> Like all clones in the show, Boil was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth Ep Guide" />

On [[November 25]], [[2011]],<ref name="TCW Ep Guide" /> Boil was featured in the episode "[[Kidnapped]],"<ref name="Kidnapped" /> which served as an adaptation of the [[2008]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]]. In the original comic book, Waxer was the one who reported to Kenobi on the progress of the battle.<ref name="TCW 1">[[The Clone Wars 1|''The Clone Wars'' 1]]</ref> However, as Waxer had [[Death/Legends|died]] in the preceding episode, "[[Carnage of Krell]]," his role was filled by Boil in "Kidnapped."<ref name="Carnage of Krell">{{TCW|Carnage of Krell}}</ref>

===Inconsistencies and non-canon adaptations===
[[File:Boil.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Boil, with red eyes]]
Boil was portrayed with red eyes in "Innocents of Ryloth,"<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> despite the fact that his progenitor Jango Fett had brown eyes.<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> The mistake was rectified in the now-defunct [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|official Encyclopedia]] on [[StarWars.com]], where Boil's eye color was changed to brown, although another error was made there, as Boil was erroneously addressed as Waxer in the opening sentence of his entry.<ref name="Encyclopedia Boil" />

Boil also appeared in the 2009 young-readers book ''[[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth]]'', which adapted "Innocents of Ryloth," but featured several inconsistencies with the episode. In the book, both Waxer and Boil initially hesitate to take Numa with them, but ultimately decide to do so and then take her straight to Kenobi, skipping the scene of the gutkurr encounter.<ref name="The Battle for Ryloth book">''[[The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth]]''</ref>

In 2011, Boil was featured in the non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', appearing in the level that adapted "Innocents of Ryloth." The [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version follows the plot of "Innocents of Ryloth" closely, while other versions of the game present a different portrayal of the television episode's events, omitting the encounter with Numa and having Waxer and Boil accompany Kenobi and Cody throughout the entire mission.<ref name="LEGO TCW">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>
